messages:
maria.garcia: Hey team — quick question ahead of my start next Monday. I moved from NJ to CA in Jan and my onboarding docs still list my old address. Two things: (1) does moving states affect when health/dental/vision become active? (2) do I need to update any state tax forms for CA before the first payroll run? Also, I was using a pre-tax commuter card at my old job — do I need to re-enroll here? Thanks!
people-ops: Welcome aboard @maria.garcia :tada: Short answers: 1) Benefits effective date is generally the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment (so if you start Mon 3/2, coverage would start 5/1). If you need retro coverage because of a prior carrier gap we can submit a special request — DM us details. 2) Yes please update your address in Rippling ASAP so payroll can apply CA tax withholding. You'll also want to complete the CA state withholding form (DE-4) if you have additional allowances. For commuter: we have a separate transit/parking pre-tax enrollment inside the benefits portal — if you want to use it here you'll need to enroll even if you had one before.
payroll-bot: FYI payroll cutoff for next paycheck is 03/05 11:59pm PT. If address/forms aren't in the system by cutoff your first check may be taxed under your old state. First pay period may also be prorated. See payroll docs: https://redwood.example.com/payroll/schedule
maria.garcia: Ack — thanks. What's the fastest way to update my address? Do you need proof (lease/utility) to switch payroll state?
people-ops: Easiest: update Rippling -> Personal Info -> Home Address. We recommend attaching a proof doc to your Rippling profile (photo of lease, gov ID, or utility bill). If you'd rather, paste the new address here and we'll update on our side, but we'll still ask for a proof upload for auditing. Example address format:
```
1234 Pacific Ave
San Francisco, CA 94109
USA
```
oliver.hr: Also file the CA DE-4 via this link (one-time): https://efile.example.com/ca-de4 — select "Redwood Inference" as employer. If you need help filling it out we can schedule a 15m walk-through.
benefits-team: For commuter: enrollment lives under Benefits -> Flexible Spending -> Transit. Enrollment is monthly and takes effect the 1st of next month after sign-up. If you moved to CA and plan to commute, enroll before 3/20 to have it apply for April. If this is for a WFH stipend instead, mention that in the enrollment notes.
maria.garcia: Perfect, I'll update Rippling and upload a lease pic today. One more quick Q — moving-related reimbursements? I got a small company relocation stipend; do I submit receipts somewhere?
people-ops: Yes — submit moving receipts to the Expenses app (Concur). Tag them with "Relocation stipend". Deadline is 60 days from your start date. If stipend was a lump sum already paid, you can still file expenses to reconcile any leftover eligible costs. Ping us if you want us to approve quickly so finance can process.
maria.garcia: Awesome, thanks everyone! I'll do the updates now. :pray:
